title: So happy to revisit Penelope at @Underbelly ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
transcript: One of my most anticipated shows of the fringe was getting to see Penelope again. This is a musical by Alex Beatle and Grace McLean that I first saw at Arlington, Virginia at the Signature Theater a few years ago. It made my top 10 musical list and it is still one of my favorite musicals. This is a beautiful one woman show about Penelope waiting for Odysseus to return and really diving into how you move on with your life and what happens when you decide to move on and life has other plans. Penelope is a beautiful folk musical with a gorgeous or. And getting to see Grace McLean jump into this role and give an absolutely master class nuance performance was a treat. If you get a chance to go see this at fringe, I cannot recommend it this enough. And if you are unable to see it at fringe, the great news is that they just released a cast recording this month that was recorded live at Joe's Pub. It is a great recording of the score. Definitely start putting it into your listening rotation. Penelope is currently playing at the Underbelly Cowgate venue here at the fringe.
